## Epistemic discipline

Specification, model proof under declared assumptions, runtime observation at one candidate, and admission are four different claims and are never collapsed. `UNRUN`, `UNKNOWN`, `STALE`, `MOCK`, `PLANNED`, `QUARANTINED` and `NOT_ADMITTED` remain nonpassing. A refusal proves the guard fired, not that the guarded operation works; a completed task is not readiness; development-ready is not system-admitted; a passing preflight, green test, board ACK, hook, model verdict or capability inventory grants no authority. Report a failure as a failure, preserve the evidence, and state what is missing rather than forcing the API.
